_: Flickers that were fixed and must stay fixed. Key: journey|kind|selector, as scripts/flicker-sweep.mjs prints it. Value: { "issue": <weave Issue number>, "why": "<what flashed>" }. The fixer adds the row's fingerprint here in the change that fixes it; test/flicker-gate-browser.test.mjs fails when one comes back.

load-home|transient|main#main > *.why: the route skeleton painted and was replaced inside one frame

open-table|transient|main#main > *.why: the route skeleton painted and was replaced inside one frame

open-row|revert|div.doc-section-body > d.why: one click on a row's #id link opened it twice, so the document editor mounted and was destroyed inside a frame

scroll-grid|shift|tbody > tr.wv-spacer.why: the probe counted the journey's own scroll: the grid re-windowed inside the scroll that caused it, in the one frame a busy host stretches past 50 ms (Issue #712)

scroll-grid|transient|tbody > *.why: the probe counted rows the reader had scrolled past before the grid recycled them

open-row|transient|div.doc-editor.vditor.why: the document editor booted on a host that was already in the dock, so its body was born and destroyed inside a frame
